## 3. DESCRIPTION (Final Public Copy — Plain Text)
Soft light begins to rise before the city wakes.
This 3-hour LoFi and Synthwave mix is designed for early mornings, calm focus, and gentle productivity. Inspired by pre-dawn light, quiet rooms, and retro CRT desks warming up for the day, the music stays steady, soft, and distraction-free.
Ideal for coding, studying, writing, or easing into the day with intention.
